summary: Avalanche Treasury Company, LLC filed an 8-K regarding a $25 million open loan from FalconX Charlie, Inc. under a Master Lender Agreement. The loan is collateralized by approximately 5.6 million AVAX tokens at a 200% initial collateral ratio, with a 7% per annum fee. Margin call triggers at 180%, default at 160%, and a refund limit at 230%. The filing is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
